function f(a: number, b: number) { delete arguments[0]; arguments[0] = 5; a = 7; arguments[1] = 8; return [a, b, arguments[0]]; }
console.log(f(1, 2));
function g(a: number, b?: number) { arguments[1] = 3; b = 4; return [b, arguments.length, arguments[1]]; }
console.log(g(1));
function h(a: number = 0) { arguments[0] = 9; return a; }
console.log(h(1));
